people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea

people.name: Herod
people.line: A Tetrarch who persecuted the early church.

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: When Herod had sought for him, and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.
translations.bsb: After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there.
translations.kjv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
translations.asv: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and tarried there.
